name: Vimta Labs Limited
summary: Vimta Labs Limited provides contract research and testing services in India and internationally. The company offers drug discovery, development, and drug life cycle management support services in the areas of preclinical research, clinical research, and analytical services for biopharmaceutical companies; preclinical research and testing services for medical device companies; and contract research and testing for agrochemical and specialty chemical companies. It also provides food testing and analytical development services to support manufacturers, processors, farmers, retailers, traders, exporters, and regulators; and a testing laboratory for water, alcoholic, and non-alcoholic beverages. …
